question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget be accepted as a sessions.list-backed builtin now, or should this issue wait for the broader per-session activity contract before it can close?
rationale: The requested UI is coherent, but choosing the durable source of truth for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent activity is a product/API sequencing decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep the staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate solution while requiring its proof, storage, security, and stack-order blockers to clear before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for the activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 or an equivalent activity API lands, then implement the widget against that richer contract.

options.title: Fold into the roadmap tracker
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own sequencing, but preserve this issue's specific status-widget requirements before closing or consolidating it.

recommendation.title: Keep the staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate solution while requiring its proof, storage, security, and stack-order blockers to clear before this issue closes.
